brief: A mustard tile inspired by Mangalagiri cotton: a fine white 8-cell window check with a gold border strip along the bottom edge mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry.

A 64x64 tile inspired by Mangalagiri handloom: 8-cell D4 body check in white on maroon, a 12-cell-tall bottom border of inverted gold checks (period 8) with a single centred dot between every pair of checks, mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry, exactly three colours, all marks on a 4x4 cell, border attached to the tile edge.
A white tile crossed by three vertical bands in the order white, red, indigo, with a thin yellow line on each side of the red band.

A black field with a row of four nested diamonds (three concentric levels, alternating red and white) repeating with period 16 along the horizontal axis, bordered top and bottom by a band of alternating red and white triangles whose tips meet to form lozenges, D2-symmetric, four inks.
A white tile with a red border on three sides and a single centred red diamond on an 8 px grid.

A counted-thread panel inspired by the phulam gamosa: red on white, all marks on a 4 px cell grid, a 12-cell-wide motif band at the bottom mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry, with a mirror-symmetric row of stepped diamonds and crosses, two plain red stripes 2 cells wide along both long edges.
A black-and-yellow border tile with a double-line outline and a centred diamond filled with evenly spaced diagonal hatching.
A two-tone wood-ground tile with a single zigzag border band and a centred diamond, mirror-symmetric left-right.

A D2-symmetric 64x64 tile in two inks (wood ground and burnt line) with an outer chevron band of period 8, an inner band of crisscross lines of period 4, and a central lozenge containing a sun disc; line coverage between 20% and 35%.
A red-and-white check tile with 8-cell squares and a thin black border stripe on one edge mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry.

A 64x64 counted-thread tile on an 8x8 cell grid: alternating red and white checks of 2 cells, a 1-cell black pinstripe every 4 cells in the warp direction only, and a 6-cell dobby border band at the bottom mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry, with translation period 4; all boundaries snapped to the cell grid.
A dark red field with a diamond of 12 small white dots in the centre and one dot in each corner.

A 64x64 counted-grid tile on 4-pixel cells: a 4x4 lattice of stepped diamonds alternating yellow/green on a red ground with a 1-cell black-and-white chequer border, D4 symmetric, no more than 5 colours, every colour boundary on a cell edge.
A rust-red tile with a single large yellow lozenge made of straight stitch runs on a 4-px grid and a white dot at the centre.

A Haryana-bagh-inspired counted-thread tile: a 64x64 grid of 4-px stitch cells fully covered by nested yellow-and-orange lozenges (each large lozenge split into three concentric bands, innermost split into four squares), D4 symmetry on the grid, a zig-zag row of small white lozenges along each border, red ground visible only as 1-cell outlines, maximum five colours.

A band design inspired by Kullu shawl ends: a symmetric stack of seven horizontal bands on black with widths in ratio 1:2:1:4:1:2:1, palette order yellow-green-white-red-white-green-yellow, each wide band carrying a zigzag with a 16 px period.

A Kamalban-inspired field of intersecting circles on a kaolin ground with exact C4 rotational symmetry: an inner ring of four circles and an outer ring of four circles around a central circle, every circle built from three concentric bands in white, red and black in that order, and a row of white dots at a fixed 6 px spacing along all four edges; four earth colours only.
A black tile inspired by Kasuti: a red stepped-diamond chain in double-running stitch style on a 4-cell grid, mirrored across the centre.
A pookalam-inspired disc of four concentric rings (white, orange, yellow, red) around a green centre, with exact C4 rotational symmetry.

A 64x64 tile whose top 44 rows are a plain peacock-blue field and whose bottom 20 rows form a reversible border mirrored about row 54: gold 2 px, crimson 3 px, a 4-px band of 2x2 gold-and-blue checks with period 4, crimson 3 px, gold 2 px; at most four colours.

A 64x64 two-colour tile (rice-white on red ochre) with D4 symmetry: a double-ruled central square whose outline is made of dots at period 3, a zigzag frieze of triangles with translation period 8 along all four edges, and total white coverage between 12% and 20%.
A white tile with a single row of black 5-step staircase triangles along the bottom edge mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry.

A cream field with a border strip on both long edges, each carrying a continuous row of 7-step black triangles (base 13 cells, period 13) with the top border inverted so the two rows are mirror images across the horizontal midline; add a thin black line two cells inside each border; two inks.

A dark field with exact D2 symmetry (mirror symmetric about both midlines): a 16-cell-high bottom border containing a row of nested diamonds (three levels: red, yellow, white) with period 16, mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry; a white zig-zag line of period 4 just above each diamond row, and small white crosses on a 5-cell grid centred between diamond tips; five inks.

A field with the mirror-symmetric lengthwise sequence red(9)-green(1)-yellow(1)-blue(1)-red(1)-black(2)-white(7)-black(1)-green(1)-red(1)-white(7) scaled to 64 cells, crossed at right angles by two solid black bands of width 4 at one-third and two-thirds of the height that fully occlude the stripes, with a row of four small yellow triangles centred in each wide white stripe; seven inks.

A black field with a mirror-symmetric band sequence orange-white-black-white-orange (widths 6:1:10:1:6) repeating with period 24 along the vertical axis, a central horizontal row of white 2x2 squares with period 4, and a one-cell white dotted border at each selvedge, four inks, no figurative marks.
A red-and-black chequerboard on an 8-cell grid with a white single-cell rudraksha-dot border on all four sides.
A rust-red tile with four yellow lozenges in the corners and a white lozenge in the centre, all on a 4-px stitch grid.
A cream tile with a black-outlined red four-petal buti in the centre and small indigo dots at the four corners.
A vertical stripe panel with a repeating group of eight thin stripes in white, red, yellow, green, black, red, white, green.
A white single-stroke loop kolam inspired by Tamil sikku kolam on a 3x3 square dot grid, every dot enclosed, D4 symmetric, on a dark ground.
A red-and-white ikat-inspired tile with a single centred stepped diamond inside a square, D4 symmetric.

A 64x64 tile inspired by Pochampally chowkra: 16-cell period, each cell a stepped diamond-within-square in red and black on white, 4x4 stitch cell, D4 symmetry, exactly three colours, with a 2-cell feathered (stepped) edge on every diamond.
A black tile with vertical stripes in the order red, white, red mirrored about the centre and a thin white line at each edge.
A square sandstone jaali panel with a plain 6-pixel frame and a regular grid of 5x5 square holes.

A chikan-jaali-inspired white tile: a bilaterally symmetric paisley outline whose interior is a diagonal (45-degree) net on a 3-px cell grid, every hole on grid, no hole touching the outline, four small corner butis, single ink colour.
A brick-red tile with a white five-pointed star inside a circle and a single white dot at the centre.

A pichhoda-inspired dot field: yellow ground, maroon dots of radius 3 on a staggered lattice with pairwise clearance >= 4 px, C4 symmetry of the dot set about the tile centre, a central dot-free disc of radius 10, and a ring of 12 smaller dots (radius 1) around that disc.
A cream stitch grid with a centred eight-point star and four small corner stars in red, mirror-symmetric on both axes.

A 64x64 strip grid (cell 4) in two natural tones forming a 2/2 twill diagonal-band repeat with period 4 in both axes, C2 symmetry, a one-cell plain-check border on all sides, and light/dark balance within 45-55%.

A phulkari-inspired tile: nested yellow/white/orange lozenges at the centre, four half-lozenges bisected by the tile edges so the pattern tiles seamlessly, D4 symmetry on a 2-px stitch grid, red ground visible only as 1-cell outlines, four colours.

A 64x64 tile, white on mud-brown with one yellow accent dot at the centre, D4 symmetric: a central square whose sides are dotted at period 2, a surrounding circle of 16 triangles alternating up/down, and all four edges carrying a dash-dot frieze with translation period 6; white coverage 10-18%.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

brief: A red-sandstone jaali tile with a 6-px solid frame and a 4x4 grid of square holes.
A light-wood panel with a grid of eight-pointed star cut-outs separated by a dark connected web.

A dot field inspired by Ladakhi thigma: 24 white rings on maroon arranged in two offset rows along a horizontal strip, centres at least 10 px apart, alternating every third ring with a small cross, mirror symmetric about the strip's vertical centre line.
A coir-brown tile with a simple 8 px check of cream squares.
A white sikku-style loop inspired by Puducherry threshold kolam on a 2x2 dot grid, one closed stroke, D4 symmetric.
